{{Nihongo|'''Katsunori Wakabayashi'''|若林 克法|Wakabayashi Katsunori}} is a [[physicist]] at the [[International Center for Materials Nanoarchitectonics]] (MANA), [[National Institute for Materials Science]] (NIMS), Japan. He is an authority and leading researcher in nanotechnology in the area of energy states of [[Single-walled carbon nanotubes#Single-walled|single wall carbon nanotubes]] (SWCN).
His research is notable for the edge effects of the [[nanographene]] materials, which is a part of the single layer [[graphene]]. He obtained his Ph.D. in 2000 from [[University of Tsukuba]] in Japan. From 2000 to 2009 he was an assistant professor at Department of Quantum Matter in [[Hiroshima University]], Japan. From 2009, he is an Independent Scientist at [[International Center for Materials Nanoarchitectonics]] (WPI-MANA), [[National Institute for Materials Science]] (NIMS) in Tsukuba, Japan. Beside the above primary research position, he was a visiting scholar at ETH-Zurich, Switzerland from 2003 to 2005, also had a concurrent position as PRESTO researcher in Japan Science and Technology Agency (JST).

==Award==
The original paper of graphene edge state and graphene nanoribbons was awarded the JPS Best Paper Award in March 2003 from the [[Physical Society of Japan]].<ref>[http://wwwsoc.nii.ac.jp/jps/jps/guide/ronbunsyo/ronbun8_03.html JPS Best Paper award] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20091208030902/http://wwwsoc.nii.ac.jp/jps/jps/guide/ronbunsyo/ronbun8_03.html |date=2009-12-08 }}</ref> He has been awarded the commendation of ministry of education, culture, sports, science and technology (MEXT), Japan in 2010 for the contribution of pioneering works on theoretical research of nanoscale effect on electronic properties of graphene.<ref>[http://www.mext.go.jp/b_menu/houdou/22/04/1292309.htm List of prize winner(in Japanese)] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140414083509/http://www.mext.go.jp/b_menu/houdou/22/04/1292309.htm |date=2014-04-14 }}</ref> In 2017, he has been awarded the JSPS Prize from Japan Society for the Promotion of Science (JSPS).<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.jsps.go.jp/english/e-jsps-prize/awards_13th_03.html |title=13th (FY2016) JSPS PRIZE Awardees |access-date=2017-09-07 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170907123606/http://www.jsps.go.jp/english/e-jsps-prize/awards_13th_03.html |archive-date=2017-09-07 }}</ref>
